summary: Quiet narrow residential street; houses 14-26 m away, flattest stretch around 45-60 m.
reasons: Houses 14-26 m away on both sides
Narrow street, no visible parking convention

best_section.where: Midway up the straight section of Newcomen Street, opposite the shaded east-side houses

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14 m (at 60 m) and 26 m (at 47 m) away, plus homes across the road; tree cover helps but residents would notice.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed local street; a few cars parked further up. Verge looks narrow and tree-lined, room to pull off is tight.
drivers.traffic: Local residential traffic only, low volume.
drivers.convention: No signs; a few cars park on the street further north but no clear parking convention.

flags: Best 15 m is about 2%, rest of the street 7-10%
Witton Creek 37 m away, elevation 28-35 m so flood risk low
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the east side; houses and trees shade much of the section.
cannot_judge: Kerb height and verge width under trees
